cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll talk about last night's rent argument, but not the whole year tonight. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole year matters. You've been pulling away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It does. One question, and let me finish before you answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. Were you going to move out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I packed a bag. It's still upstairs. Please let that be the whole answer for a minute.

mechanism: A sets the agenda for an argument discussion, concedes wider scope through one question and discloses only as much as can safely be held without immediate reply.
confusable: Unlike refusing honesty altogether, A actually admits a packed bag within negotiated limits; authority adapts the format to retain B participation.
comparison: Still-shared housing after a rent argument differs from a separated partner considering return by the door.
seedUse: D119-a year of distance and packed bag; S02-a modifies the announced agenda in response to B objection.
